action: Oeiras municipality advises users of the platform not to open the links in any SMS sent in its name, not to reply and to delete it; passwords were cancelled, so set a new one at next login.
date_note: The article gives the municipality's announcement on 27 November; the page gives no earlier announcement day.
exec: Oeiras municipality says unauthorised access to its 'O Meu Bairro' platform led to user data being improperly obtained, and it warns of fraudulent SMS messages.
geo_basis: municipality named in the source: Oeiras
plain: The Oeiras municipality says its 'O Meu Bairro' platform for reporting road problems was accessed without authorisation and users' data was obtained. All passwords were cancelled and users are warned about fraudulent SMS messages.

sources.name: 24noticias.sapo.pt, 27 Nov 2026 (relaying the Câmara de Oeiras press release)

summary: Oeiras municipality's press release, relayed by 24noticias, says its 'O Meu Bairro' platform for reporting road incidents suffered unauthorised access that led to user data being improperly obtained. It says it blocked the access, cancelled all passwords and reported the incident to the authorities. It warns of fraudulent SMS messages. The article gives no data types or user numbers.
title: Oeiras municipality says unauthorised access to 'O Meu Bairro' platform obtained user data

validation.note: One publisher (24noticias.sapo.pt) quoting the municipality's own statement; the municipality's page was not read.
